d:
Pradhanmantri narendr modi ne nitish setu ka udghatan kiya, jiske bad ilake ke logon men is pul ko lekar ummiden hain.
Dudh bechne valon se lekar sabji vikretaon tak ne bataya ki nae pul se unke karobar aur rojmarra ke saphar par kya asar parega.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
